description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing lock/hide schedule rules in a database, using Android Room library annotations.

classes.name: LockRuleDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for performing database operations related to LockRule entities.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of all LockRule instances, ordered by triggerAtMillis ascending.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a LockRule into the database, replacing any existing rule with the same primary key.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified LockRule from the database.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes the LockRule with the specified id from the database.
